newsitem.title: USA: Pete's Brewing sees Q4 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Pete's Brewing sees Q4 EPS below estimates.

text.p: Pete's Brewing Co said Wednesday it expects to earnings for the fourth quarter will be below analysts' estimates.

The company said in a statement it expects earnings per share for its fourth quarter to be in the range of $0.00 to $0.02 with earnings per share for the fiscal year in the range of $0.15 to $0.17, below current analyst consensus of $0.07 for the quarter and $0.23 for the years.

The company said it had unanticipated cost increases and shortfalls in volume expectations in the fourth quarter 1996 caused by distributor transitions in several key markets, including California, Colorado and Washington, D.C.

Pete's said it expects lower than anticipated margins in the fourth quarter due to increased freight costs principally from the distributor transition in California, and incremental expenses due to responding to necessary transition adjustments. Fourth quarter cost issues are expected to be short term, but may have some impact on first quarter 1997 margins, the company said.

In October Pete's moved its California distribution system from a single distributor to 31 beer wholesalers. Additional distributor changes were initiated during the fourth quarter in Denver and Washington, D.C. markets.
Pete's Brewing will report its fourth quarter and year-ended 1997 earnings on February 25.
